independent_checks.finding: Links both study identifiers and repeats a comma-separated symptom list without a connective. Its protocol URL, results URL and date of first publication fields are empty. This source mirrors the registration.
The intervention arm again refers to the symptom complex generally; the criteria list symptoms without an explicit AND or OR. Pregnancy and postmenopausal bleeding are not separate listed exclusions.

The article expressly permits alternative presenting symptoms and reports 404 participants, through August 2015. It excludes pregnant and postmenopausal-bleeding participants in addition to refusal. Its ethics statement gives no trial registration or protocol identifier.

clinical_claim: The patient reports severe menstrual pelvic pain, heavy irregular periods, and intermittent intermenstrual spotting. She would meet an any-one-of-listed-symptoms rule at presentation. Dyspareunia and qualifying chronic duration are undocumented.
unresolved: The paper is a plausible same-team study but no usable source establishes that its symptom policy applies to the frozen registration. The close correspondence permits a separately reported conditional analysis.
